Research intent:
Investigate richer image supervision from the user-selected baseline06 I_VR_P0, not an assumed pose-only or YOLO-generated model. Existing selected independent architecture has separate audio encoders for accent, chromatic change and palette, Rich96 image auxiliary, pose_aux_dim0. Current image observer uses SAM2 box-prompted person masks with YOLO-derived cached boxes and excludes UI/people; 72 hue-saturation bins+24 quadrant descriptors, brightness-derived accent targets. No full-scene semantic representation or validated independent light labels. User reports strong track/rhythm match on Shpongle but this is one-song informed feedback. Next scoped study should inspect image targets, mask/UI/shot-cut contamination and temporal visual structure, establish independently annotated useful changes on a bounded TRAIN/DEV pilot, and compare current descriptors against a richer image/temporal representation with appropriate audio and visual nulls. Replacing YOLO alone is a separate masking intervention, not a demonstrated route to better lighting. No new fitting, dataset enlargement, test access or claimed advantage is authorized by this queue entry alone; preregister actual controlled pilot before computation. Keep previous observer29/30 null gate and negative palette-history results intact. First review baseline06 history/fade A/B.

Additional local finding: current demo mapping reduces each palette token to one global RGB and applies it to all color-enabled fixtures; there is no learned fixture-wise color assignment. A richer image representation and a spatial fixture-color output mapping are separate interventions. See updated experiments/2026-09-29-baseline/records/IMAGE_SUPERVISION_NEXT.md. Current inference/model outputs stay unchanged.
